annotation_quantization: nearest microsecond, positive half ties upward
prefix: four annotated beats strictly before each window, all in the same constant segment that contains the window start
change: exactly one annotated tempo_jump between adjacent constant segments with different BPM; before and after both inside window
pair: same track, same prechange constant segment, same duration; constant window ends no later than change window starts
per_track_choice: earliest pairable change point; most time-balanced change window; earlier change start; latest nonoverlapping constant window
global_duration_choice: maximum pairable track count; ties choose longer; no pairs means null
rubato: untyped for discrete constant-versus-step roles; do not infer labels from interval variation
